detail.longDescription: Upgrading FastMCP to 4.1.2 does not close its OAuth credential leak. You also have to pass issuer=. In 4.0.0 to 4.1.1, the client-credentials and private-key-JWT providers used whatever authorization server an MCP server advertised, so a hostile server could receive your client secret. In 4.1.2, omitting issuer still works, with only a deprecation warning. Set it, then rotate the secret. https:// github.com/advisories/GHSA-vqq p-x5qm-5qp4 # MCP # AIAgents # Cybersecurity # Python
